items.title: AFCS Architecture and Failure Logic
items.description: How the S-92's Automatic Flight Control System is built up layer by layer, followed through a real flight to show how the modes actually work together — plus every AFCS failure mode.

items.title: Fire: Protection Logic and Procedures
items.description: How the fire detection and extinguishing system is built, followed through a real engine fire from first indication to a safe outcome.

items.title: Hydraulic: Triple-Redundant Systems
items.description: How the S-92's multiply-redundant hydraulic system is built and protects itself, followed through a real hydraulic failure from first caution to a safe outcome.

items.title: Electrical: Architecture and Failure Logic
items.description: How the S-92's electrical system generates, converts, and distributes power, followed through a real dual generator failure to show exactly how the system protects itself and what the pilot does.
